svg.title: STEM: evidence memory construction and query-time retrieval
svg.desc: An original research schematic. On the left, a continuous helmet video is indexed in thirty-second leaves. A source-linked description yields action, state, identifier and summary keys, bound to original video and uncertain zone context in a memory table. An optional Work Episode overlay preserves direct leaf access. On the right, evidence-slot subqueries retrieve and fuse global and scoped candidates, expand temporal neighbors, filter relevance and verify claims in source video. Missing evidence triggers bounded search. Daily Reports traverse the complete scope separately. Scenes and records are illustrative, not measured results.
